		function loadScriptOnce(url) {
			// Check if the script has already been loaded
			if (document.querySelector('script[src="${url}"]')) {
				console.log('Script already loaded: ${url}');
				return Promise.resolve(); // Return a resolved promise if already loaded
			}

			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const script = document.createElement('script');
				script.type = 'text/javascript';
				script.src = url;
				script.async = true; // Load asynchronously to avoid blocking page rendering

				script.onload = () => {
					console.log('Script loaded: ${url}');
					resolve();
				};

				script.onerror = () => {
					console.error('Error loading script: ${url}');
					reject(new Error('Failed to load script: ${url}'));
				};

				document.head.appendChild(script);
			});
		}

		function getCacheDTN(key) {
			try {
				const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
				if (!item) return null;
				const data = JSON.parse(item);
				if (Date.now() > data.expiry) {
					localStorage.removeItem(key);
					return null;
				}
				return data.value;
			} catch (e) {
				return null;
			}
		}

		function setCacheDTN(key, value, ttlMinutes = 30) {
			try {
				const data = {
					value: value,
					expiry: Date.now() + (ttlMinutes * 60 * 1000)
				};
				localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
			} catch (e) {
				console.error('Cache error:', e);
			}
		}

		function getCookieDTN(name) {
			const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
			const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
			if (parts.length === 2) return parts.pop().split(';').shift();
		}

		function setCookieDTN(name, value, days = 365) {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
